packageRules.description: maplibre_gl belongs to one exact maplibre-gl-js (app/web/maplibre/README.md): never automatically
prBodyNotes: Check `kMapLibreJsVersion` in maplibre_gl_web and update `app/web/maplibre/` to exactly that version.

packageRules.description: Valhalla's major is also the version of the traffic.tar format (importer/src/homemaps_traffic/traffictile.py)
prBodyNotes: `TILE_VERSION` in traffictile.py must equal VALHALLA_VERSION_MAJOR; otherwise Valhalla silently ignores all live traffic.
